description: NVIDIA vGPU Virtual GPU Manager for Linux contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause incorrect resource transfer between spheres. A successful exploit of this vulnerability might lead to code execution, denial of service, escalation of privileges, information disclosure, and data tampering.
